# DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017: the open model that got faster and cheaper

## Hook

DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on Hugging Face on October 17, 2026, and the weights are free to download under the MIT License.

## What changed

DeepSeek calls it a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, "delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks."
On Terminal-Bench 4.0 the new checkpoint scores 42.3, up from 31.2 for the previous Flash release.
On DeepSWE v1.1 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 scores 77.0, ahead of GPT-5.6 Sol at 73.0.
On Terminal-Bench 4.0 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 also beats Opus 5 with 51.8.
It keeps a 1M tokens context window.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 was trained on 40 trillion tokens.

## Why it matters

Think of the context window as a desk: the bigger the desk, the more papers the model can spread out at once.
DeepSeek's founder and CEO Liang Wenfeng has built the lab around releasing open weights.
